issues.issue: This is interest owed by property owners on special assessments that was written off, not interest the district paid on its debt. general government (or a reduction of special assessment revenue) may fit better. Amount is correct.

Fiscal/paying agent fees relate to the bonds and warrants, so debt service interest (which includes fees) is defensible. The same applies to detail[6] and detail[23] (detail_category professional/contract services vs debt interest and fees). Judgment call; amounts are correct.
